blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Is Calvin Abueva serious about hanging it up after the PBA season? The Converge forward hinted at retirement on Wednesday, the same day he was fined a total of P24,000 for his actions during the FiberXers’ Game 4 win over the Rain or Shine Elasto Painters in the 2016 Governors’ Cup quarterfinals. Abueva made it known in a Facebook Live video, telling everyone to enjoy watching him while he’s still on the PBA hardcourt. “To my fans, we won’t be seeing each other next year.
